answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the lagoon check immediately, the ember audit keeps the resolved set and the jetty replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 143 aliases hence forfeits the reading cost 143 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
